captures.label: baseline-3.12.0
notes: Read-only: the CLI was given the Read tool alone, session persistence disabled, and no file was written into a scenario directory by a run.
The three scenarios were captured concurrently; runs within a scenario are sequential.
This release has no domain classification, so the selection field carries generic question categories whose names vary between runs. Scored with the domain check disabled.
Only the structured result of each run is retained. Per-run cost, latency, and session ids are not recorded.

captures.label: retained-3.12.0-2026-07-23
captures.provenance: Ported from the source edition's scenario fixtures, where it is the Claude-side reading taken alongside that edition's own capture.
notes: A single run per scenario. It fixes a point, not a distribution, and cannot be compared to a median on equal terms.
Field naming follows the source edition; the loader maps it on read.
